prompt: A garden is a $20 \times 15$ rectangle. A $5 \times 5$ pond sits in one corner. What is the **area of the garden NOT covered by the pond**?
hint: The pond takes up part of the garden. The area that is not pond is the garden's area with the pond's area taken off.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Shrink the problem: a $4 \times 3$ garden with a $1 \times 1$ pond has $12 - 1 = 11$ squares of garden left.
The pond takes up part of the garden. The area that is not pond is the garden's area with the pond's area taken off.
The garden is $20 \times 15 = 300$ and the pond is $5 \times 5 = 25$. Subtract the pond from the garden.
$300 - 25 = 275$, so $275$ square units of the garden are not covered by the pond.

explanation: Find the area of the whole garden: $20 \times 15 = 300$ square units.
Find the area of the pond in the corner: $5 \times 5 = 25$ square units.
The pond lies inside the garden, so subtract it: $300 - 25 = 275$.
The area not covered by the pond is $275$ square units.
